# PointLight

- Inherits [`Instance`](instance.md)
- Created with `Instance.new("PointLight")`

A light that shines equally in every direction. Parented to a `BasePart` or an `Attachment`, it shines from there and moves with it. Parented to anything else, it shines from its own `CFrame`.

This page lists the members this class declares. Inherited members are
listed on the page of the class that declares them.

## Properties

| Name | Type | Default | Access | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `Brightness` | `number` | — | read/write | How much light is emitted. At 0 the light emits nothing. |
| `CFrame` | `CFrame` | — | read/write | The position of the light. When the light is parented to a `BasePart` or an `Attachment`, this is relative to that parent, and the identity puts the light at the parent. Otherwise it is in world space. |
| `Color` | `Color3` | — | read/write | The color of the light, multiplied by `Brightness`. It is not clamped, so a channel above 1 gives an over-bright tint. |
| `Enabled` | `boolean` | `true` | read/write | Whether the light shines. A disabled light does not count toward the limit on lights drawn at once; a light with a `Brightness` of 0 does. |
| `Range` | `number` | — | read/write | The radius, in meters, beyond which the light has no effect. A smaller range is cheaper to draw. |
| `Shadows` | `boolean` | — | read/write | Whether the light casts shadows.<br><br>A point light's shadow uses six of the sixteen tiles in the shadow atlas, one for each face of a cube around the light. A `SpotLight` uses one. Two point lights and four spot lights fill the atlas.<br><br>When more lights ask for shadows than there are tiles, the lights that are nearest and largest on screen cast them and the others do not. The choice is stable from frame to frame, so shadows do not flicker. |
